title: valeriana acutiloba var. pubicarpa
intro: Valeriana acutiloba var. pubicarpa, commonly known as a variety of Valerian root, is a plant species within the Valerianaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana acutiloba var. pubicarpa are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are believed to be caused by its ability to modulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isovaleric acid, valerenic acid, and valepotriates, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
